titin_I_band_extension_provenance.superseded_because: the previous partition (prox_Ig 81.1 / N2A 7.5 / PEVK 15.7 / dist_Ig 20.7) was inferred independently of the other states; inverting each region against its sourced force-extension law gave forces spanning 41.2x (0.09-3.85 pN), and a series chain must bear ONE common force.
titin_I_band_extension_provenance.total_unchanged: the I-band TOTAL is bit-identical to the superseded partition (125.0 nm), so no filament, overlap, M-line or lattice geometry moved.
titin_I_band_extension_provenance.precision_note: stored to 0.001 nm — far below any measurement's resolution, but required so the per-region implied-force inversion stays faithful: near N2A's rigid folded-domain floor the coil is barely extended, and 0.05 nm of rounding shifts N2A's implied force by ~22%, which would show up as a spurious force-spread failure rather than a real inconsistency.

transition_rules.interpolation: linear in SL for filament positions; nonlinear (recruitment-order) for titin I-band elements — use titin_I_band_extension per state, do not linearly scale titin uniformly.
transition_rules.lattice: d10 follows constant-volume law d10 ∝ 1/sqrt(SL); labelled idealization for quasi-static change.
forbidden: Do not extend the A-band (thick filament) length.
Do not uniformly stretch titin — I-band only.
Do not depict Ig domain unfolding during normal contraction (physiological fold/unfold 6-8 pN, rare).
Do not animate active titin force generation as established (contested hypothesis).
transition_rules.evidence_class: STRONGLY INFERRED (extension partition); MEASURED (filament lengths, SL states, lattice law)

domain_unfolding.directive: Represent Ig unfolding only as a rare/extreme state, clearly labelled, never as ordinary contraction.

I_band_partition_correction.what_changed: All four keyframe I-band partitions were re-derived by series force balance. Previously each was independently inferred, and the inferences were not mutually consistent.
I_band_partition_correction.why: The four I-band elastic regions are in mechanical SERIES between the Z-disc and the thick-filament tip, so they must bear a COMMON force. Inverting each region of the previous partitions independently gave forces spanning 41x (contracted), 16x (resting) and 553x (stretched) — not states a real chain can adopt. The stretched partition was the worst: it held N2A and PEVK EXACTLY constant from resting, so the entire +100 nm of stretch fell on the two Ig tandems, driving dist_Ig to 98.7% of contour = 277.5 pN. That sits inside the 150-300 pN AFM regime domain_unfolding classifies as EXTREME / non-physiological and that transition_rules.forbidden bars depicting as ordinary contraction. Correcting stretched alone then exposed that the N2A column DECREASED with stretch (12.0 -> 3.2 nm), which a series chain forbids; the inconsistency was never confined to one state.
I_band_partition_correction.corroboration: The corrected common forces (0.116 / 0.517 / 1.473 / 10.359 pN) match the scale 10.1073/pnas.95.14.8052 reports for skeletal titin — ~1.5 pN at comparable SL, rising to ~8 pN near SL 2.9 um. Persistence lengths were taken from that literature and never fitted to this spec, so the agreement is corroboration, not a fit.
I_band_partition_correction.what_did_NOT_change: Every state's I-band TOTAL is unchanged, so filament positions, overlap, the M-line, the lattice and all A-band geometry are bit-identical. Only titin's internal region boundaries moved.
I_band_partition_correction.evidence_class: MODELED (series force balance over MEASURED chain parameters) — was STRONGLY INFERRED (independent per-state inference), then 'STRONGLY INFERRED (MODELED: ...)' while the vocabulary was closed at five classes
I_band_partition_correction.gate: scripts/validate_geometry.py enforces per-state force-spread <= 3.0x and monotone extension, so this class of defect cannot re-enter.
I_band_partition_correction.evidence_class_rationale: The closed vocabulary defines six evidence classes: MEASURED / STRONGLY INFERRED / MODELED / INFERRED / SCHEMATIC / UNKNOWN. A common-force partition is an executable model output derived from measured chain parameters and an established polymer law, not a direct observation; MODELED is therefore the honest class, and SpecLoader enforces it.
